adjust.description: Price adjustment mode, such as qfq (forward), hfq (backward), or none.

end_date.description: End date of the history range, as YYYY-MM-DD.

fallback.description: When true, fall back to another source if the chosen source fails.

indicators_list.description: Technical indicators to compute alongside the bars, such as SMA or RSI.

interval.description: Bar interval unit, such as day, week, or month.

interval_multiplier.description: Interval multiplier, for example 5 with interval minute gives 5-minute bars.

recent_n.description: Return only the most recent N bars.

source.description: Data source to query, such as yahoo, sina, or eastmoney.

start_date.description: Start date of the history range, as YYYY-MM-DD.

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol, for example AAPL.
